goal: Introduce Moer::Synapse as an engine-owned immediate UI layer over ImGui so editor-facing UI code builds panels and widgets through Synapse contracts instead of calling ImGui directly. Synapse owns theme tokens, icon access, widget composition, panel chrome, docking layout helpers, and panel-specific style scopes while the existing render-owned ImGui integration continues to own context lifetime, IO, draw-data recording, platform viewports, and presentation.

direct_imgui_exposure: EditorUI includes imgui.h and imgui_internal.h and directly calls ImGui for frame composition, dockspace creation, menu bars, panels, scene hover detection, config controls, and style selection.
RasterUI and RaytracingUI are renderer-specific editor panels that directly call ImGui for tree sections, selectable lists, sliders, checkboxes, disabled state, and debug text.
EditorUIStyle writes ImGuiStyle directly and exposes style selection through an ImGui combo. Theme data is not represented as engine-owned tokens.
existing_render_boundary: Render::UIRenderer and ImGUIRenderBackend already own ImGui frame begin/end, input snapshot capture, draw-data recording, image registration, platform viewport rendering, and PresentationSurface-backed extra viewport presentation.
ImGUIRenderBackend already loads the FontAwesome icon font and a Chinese font into the ImGui atlas.
The imgui_window_decoupling milestone already fixes that ImGuiIntegration owns native IO and presentation. Synapse must build on that boundary instead of introducing a second ImGui backend.
current_state.design_problem: UI authoring code and style policy are still coupled to raw ImGui symbols. This makes widget consistency hard, leaks ImGui internals into editor panels, and makes future UI style or backend changes require broad call-site edits.

hard_constraints.title: Moer::Synapse is the only editor-facing immediate UI namespace
hard_constraints.detail: New editor and engine UI authoring code should use Moer::Synapse types and functions. Raw ImGui calls are allowed only inside the Synapse implementation and the existing render-owned ImGui backend.

hard_constraints.title: Do not modify ImGui source or fork the backend
hard_constraints.detail: Synapse wraps the existing ImGui API and existing Moer render integration. It must not patch third-party ImGui files, create a custom platform backend, or duplicate draw-data recording.

hard_constraints.title: Object-owned context, not process-global UI state
hard_constraints.detail: The public Synapse entry point should be an owned Synapse::Context object passed to UI composition code. Static helpers may exist only for compile-time constants or local implementation details, not as the main state or lifetime model.

hard_constraints.title: No wrapper-only abstraction
hard_constraints.detail: Do not expose one-to-one pass-through functions for every ImGui call. Add Synapse widgets only when they encode engine style, layout invariants, ID policy, scoped state, or repeated multi-step behavior.

hard_constraints.title: Keep render integration ownership unchanged
hard_constraints.detail: Render::UIRenderer continues to own BeginGUIFrame, EndGUIFrame, RenderGUI, PresentWindows, image registration, input snapshots, and platform viewport targets. Synapse consumes that frame boundary but does not own render or platform presentation.

hard_constraints.title: Latest-only migration
hard_constraints.detail: When UI call sites migrate, remove direct ImGui usage from those call sites instead of keeping parallel Synapse and ImGui paths as long-term compatibility.

hard_constraints.title: Docking and panel style are separate policies
hard_constraints.detail: Dockspace creation/layout policy and individual panel chrome/style policy must be separate modules. PanelHeader is a Synapse panel primitive, not scattered BeginMenuBar or SeparatorText usage.

module_location.reason: The layer is engine-owned and can be reused by editor, runtime tools, and future profiler/editor surfaces without living under source/editor.
module_location.dependency_rule: The module may depend on Core and the existing render UI frame boundary. It should keep ImGui includes private to .cpp files where practical.

primary_objects.name: Synapse::Context
primary_objects.role: Per-UI-host immediate context object used by editor UI code during a frame.
owns: Theme reference or owned theme state
Stable ID helpers for widget paths
Access to the current Render::UIRenderer frame services when needed

primary_objects.name: Synapse::Theme
primary_objects.role: Engine-owned design tokens for colors, sizes, typography, icon metrics, spacing, rounding, panel chrome, and docking visuals.
owns: Color tokens such as text, muted text, accent, danger, panel background, panel border, toolbar background, header background, selection, and graph/debug colors
Dimension tokens such as row height, icon button size, toolbar height, header height, property label width, frame padding, section spacing, and separator thickness
Font roles such as default, small, mono, icon, and title if the backend exposes font handles later
One application method that maps tokens to ImGuiStyle at frame or startup boundaries

primary_objects.name: Synapse::IconSet
primary_objects.role: Named icon lookup over the already loaded FontAwesome atlas. UI code asks for semantic icons instead of embedding raw glyph constants everywhere.
owns: Semantic icon enum names such as Play, Stop, FolderOpen, Search, Settings, Warning, ChevronRight, Eye, Camera, Save, Reload
Icon glyph lookup and fallback glyph policy
Icon text sizing policy for IconButton and toolbar controls

primary_objects.name: Synapse::Widget
primary_objects.role: Composable widget primitives that encode Moer style and behavior over immediate-mode calls.

primary_objects.name: Synapse::Panel
primary_objects.role: Panel lifecycle and panel chrome layer for editor surfaces.

layering.responsibility: Store tokens and apply backend style mapping. This replaces EditorUIStyle as the canonical style source.

Provide reusable immediate widgets with fixed ID, layout, style, and state conventions. Widgets may call ImGui internally but never leak ImGui types through editor-facing signatures unless a backend-only escape hatch is explicitly marked internal.
Own panel begin/end, header, toolbar, docking, menu/panel chrome, and panel-local style scopes. Panel code composes widgets rather than exposing raw ImGui Begin/End semantics to editor code.
EditorUI, RasterUI, RaytracingUI, console, and profiler-facing panels call Synapse only. They hold domain state and callbacks, not backend UI details.

context_usage_shape: EditorUI owns Synapse::Context as a member next to Render::UIRenderer.
EditorUI::TickUI starts the render-owned GUI frame, creates or resets Synapse frame state, builds panels through Synapse, applies input snapshot, then ends the GUI frame.
Renderer-specific config sections should eventually receive Synapse::Context& instead of std::function<void()> with hidden raw ImGui calls.
signature_style: Prefer concrete small structs for widget parameters: IconButtonDesc, PanelDesc, PropertyGridDesc, ToolbarDesc.
Use bool return values only for meaningful user actions, for example clicked, changed, opened, or accepted.
Avoid generic pass-through flags mirroring ImGui flags. Expose Moer-level intent such as PanelStyle::DockedTool, PanelStyle::Viewport, ButtonRole::Primary, ButtonRole::Danger.
imgui_type_policy: No imgui.h include in Synapse public headers in the target state.
If a temporary implementation slice must expose a backend value, keep it under a clearly internal header and do not use it from editor panel code.
ImGuiID, ImGuiWindowFlags, ImVec2, ImVec4, and ImFont should not appear in editor-facing panel/widget signatures. Use Moer math and Synapse token types instead.

requirements: Replace EditorUIStyle with Synapse::Theme plus one ImGuiStyle mapper inside the Synapse ImGui backend adapter.
Keep docking colors and panel colors separate so dock preview/empty background changes do not leak into regular panel widgets.
Represent sizes as named tokens rather than scattered PushItemWidth, Dummy, SameLine, and hard-coded pixel values.
Use the existing FontAwesome font atlas loaded by ImGUIRenderBackend.
Expose semantic icon names through Synapse::Icon.
IconButton and ToolbarButton should handle icon alignment, hit target size, tooltip text, disabled state, and optional active/selected state.

property_grid: PropertyGrid owns two-column label/value layout, label width, row spacing, disabled row handling, and change reporting.
Property rows should support bool, integer, float, vector, enum, path picker, color, text, and read-only value display through explicit row descriptors.
Renderer config panels should migrate sliders and checkboxes into PropertyGrid rows instead of hand-written tree sections.
toolbar_bottom: ToolBarBottom owns a fixed-height bottom toolbar with grouped icon buttons, status slots, and optional right-aligned diagnostics.
The editor play/stop/eject controls should migrate from menu-bar text buttons to semantic toolbar buttons when the layout checkpoint lands.
scene_viewport: SceneViewportPanel should report content rect, hovered/active state, separate-window state, and render target request data through Synapse types.
It should replace direct FindWindowByName, ParentWindow, MenuBarRect, and raw viewport math in EditorUI once panel migration starts.

panel_header: PanelHeader draws the canonical title/chrome line for panels and owns optional icon, title, subtitle, close button, pin/lock state, menu button, and trailing action buttons.
PanelHeader should be reusable inside docked panels and standalone platform viewports without hard-coding ImGui menu bars into every panel.
PanelHeader returns structured actions rather than forcing the caller to inspect ImGui button state directly.
docking: Docking is a panel/layout service, not a widget. It owns main dockspace setup, default layout rules, and dock node rebuild policy.
DefaultEditorDockLayout should replace EditorUI::SetupDefaultDockLayout and keep Scene Color, Configs, Console, and runtime profiler placement rules in one place.
Docking style tokens should be applied separately from panel body/widget tokens.

target_frame_order: EditorUI builds dockspace, menu, scene viewport, config, overlays, and registered panels through Synapse
Renderer records main UI draw data through Render::UIRenderer::RenderGUI()
lifetime: EditorUI constructs Synapse::Context after UIRenderer exists and before first UI frame.
Synapse::Context does not outlive the render-owned ImGui context.
Theme and icon registry can be owned by Synapse::Context in the first implementation; move to a larger UI host only when multiple UI hosts need shared theme state.

non_goals: No custom renderer or ImGui draw-data replacement.
No compatibility layer that keeps editor panels freely mixing Synapse and raw ImGui long-term.
No generic skinning/plugin framework before concrete editor requirements exist.
No attempt to make Synapse backend-agnostic in the first landing; it is an ImGui-backed immediate UI layer with ImGui hidden behind the Synapse implementation boundary.

checkpoints.title: Create the Synapse module and object context
checkpoints.problem: There is no engine-owned UI authoring boundary. Editor UI code owns raw ImGui calls and style stack behavior directly.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: A Moer::Synapse module exists with an owned Synapse::Context object.
Synapse public headers do not expose imgui.h to editor-facing code.
Synapse::Context has explicit BeginFrame and EndFrame hooks with stack-balance validation in debug builds.
EditorUI owns a Synapse::Context member but still preserves existing behavior through the first small migrated surface.
tasks: Add source/runtime/ui/synapse module files and CMake integration.
Define Synapse::Context, Synapse::FrameInfo, and minimal style/panel stack accounting.
Inject or reference Render::UIRenderer services without taking over render frame ownership.
Keep ImGui includes private to the implementation file unless a specific internal backend header requires them.

checkpoints.title: Move style into Theme and icon tokens
checkpoints.problem: EditorUIStyle is a static ImGuiStyle writer and icon usage is not represented as semantic engine UI data.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: Synapse::Theme owns Moer UI color, size, typography, icon, panel, and docking tokens.
One Synapse ImGui mapper applies Theme tokens to ImGuiStyle.
EditorUIStyle is removed or reduced to no target architectural role after migration.
Icons are addressed by Synapse::Icon semantic names, not by raw glyph literals in editor code.
tasks: Define Theme token structs for colors, spacing, dimensions, panel chrome, docking visuals, and font roles.
Define Synapse::Icon enum and icon lookup table backed by FontAwesome glyph constants.
Replace EditorUIStyle::ApplyDefaultStyle and ShowStyleSelector usage with Synapse theme application and theme selection widget.
Keep backend font loading in ImGUIRenderBackend for now; Synapse consumes the already loaded icon font.

checkpoints.title: Introduce core widgets with real behavior
checkpoints.problem: Current panel code repeats ImGui tree, selectable, slider, checkbox, disabled, and layout logic directly without shared Moer UI behavior.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: Synapse has concrete widgets for IconButton, ToolbarButton, PropertyGrid, Section, EnumCombo, SelectableList, scalar/vector sliders, and status text.
Each widget encodes Moer style and layout invariants rather than only forwarding to one ImGui call.
At least one low-risk config section is migrated to Synapse widgets to validate the API shape.
Migrated code no longer includes imgui.h for those widgets.
tasks: Define widget descriptor structs and action/change result types.
Implement PropertyGrid with row label/value layout and scoped disabled behavior.
Implement IconButton and ToolbarButton using Synapse::Icon, fixed hit target size, active/disabled state, and tooltip support.
Migrate a contained EditorUI config subsection before touching all RasterUI and RaytracingUI controls.

checkpoints.title: Move docking and panel chrome into Synapse panels
checkpoints.problem: Dockspace setup, default layout, panel begin/end, panel header, and menu/header behavior are scattered through EditorUI and raw ImGui internals.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: Synapse owns BeginDockspace, DefaultEditorDockLayout, BeginPanel, EndPanel, PanelHeader, and PanelToolbar primitives.
EditorUI::SetupDefaultDockLayout is replaced by a Synapse docking layout service.
Scene Color, Configs, Console, and runtime profiler layout rules are represented as Synapse panel layout data.
PanelHeader is the canonical panel chrome path for panels that need header actions.
tasks: Define PanelDesc, PanelHeaderDesc, DockspaceDesc, and DockPanelPlacement types.
Move main editor dockspace setup out of EditorUI into Synapse panel/docking code.
Implement PanelHeader with icon/title/actions and panel-local style scope.
Keep docking style tokens separate from general widget and panel body tokens.

checkpoints.title: Replace editor and renderer config UI call sites
checkpoints.problem: Renderer-specific config UI and editor overlay registration still accept callbacks that can hide raw ImGui calls indefinitely.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: EditorUI, RasterUI, and RaytracingUI build visible UI through Synapse for migrated sections.
Renderer config registration accepts Synapse::Context& or a Synapse panel builder contract instead of std::function<void()> as the long-term authoring shape.
Direct ImGui includes are removed from migrated editor-facing UI files.
No compatibility path remains for new renderer config panels to call ImGui directly.
tasks: Change renderer config section registration to pass Synapse::Context& through the callback.
Migrate common EditorUI controls first, then RasterUI, then RaytracingUI.
Replace repeated tree/slider/checkbox/selectable patterns with PropertyGrid and Section widgets.
Delete stale ImGui includes and direct style calls from migrated files.

checkpoints.title: Lock validation and direct ImGui boundary
checkpoints.problem: UI abstraction migrations can compile while still leaking ImGui headers or breaking layout/input behavior at runtime.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: The build passes through the repository build path.
Runtime smoke coverage validates docking, Scene Color hover/camera focus, play/stop/eject controls, Configs panel controls, detached Scene Color, and shutdown.
A source audit shows raw ImGui usage in editor-facing UI code is limited to unmigrated files or fully gone for the chosen landing scope.
Validation uses existing repository commands only.
tasks: Run just b after implementation changes.
Run just r when runtime UI behavior changes and allow enough startup time for validation errors to surface.
If just is unavailable, use the repository-defined equivalent build/run path documented in AGENTS.md.
Use source search only as an audit aid; do not add ad-hoc validation scripts.

execution_order: CP-01: create the object-owned Synapse context and module boundary first.
CP-02: move style and icons into Theme/IconSet before broad widget migration.
CP-03: add core widgets and prove them on a small config surface.
CP-04: move docking and panel chrome after Theme and basic widgets exist.
CP-05: migrate EditorUI, RasterUI, and RaytracingUI call sites without keeping a long-term mixed API.
CP-06: validate build/runtime behavior and audit the direct ImGui boundary.

risks.risk: A shallow Synapse API can become a second naming layer over ImGui.
risks.mitigation: Only add widgets that own style/layout/state invariants. Leave rare one-off debug UI on raw ImGui until it has a real Synapse abstraction or is migrated as part of a panel.

risks.risk: Docking and detached viewport behavior can regress if Synapse starts owning render/presentation state.
risks.mitigation: Keep Render::UIRenderer and PresentationSurface as the only render/presentation owners. Synapse may query panel state and content rects but must not create or present swapchains.

risks.risk: Icon and font assumptions can break if FontAwesome atlas loading changes.
risks.mitigation: Keep icon lookup semantic and backend-backed. Add a clear missing-glyph fallback and keep font atlas ownership in the render ImGui backend until a font service is justified.

risks.risk: Renderer config callbacks can preserve hidden raw ImGui usage indefinitely.
risks.mitigation: Change the registration contract during migration so new renderer UI sections receive Synapse::Context& and cannot be authored as anonymous raw ImGui closures.

acceptance_criteria: A planning-only design exists in this checkpoint before code changes begin.
The target design uses Moer::Synapse and an owned Synapse::Context object.
Theme, Widget, and Panel layers are explicitly separated.
Icon support, docking style separation, panel style separation, and PanelHeader are first-class design elements.
The design explicitly avoids ImGui source modification and avoids duplicating existing render-owned ImGui integration.
Implementation checkpoints specify a path to remove raw ImGui exposure from editor-facing UI code.
validation: This checkpoint is documentation-only. No build or runtime validation is required for this file itself.
When implementation begins, validate with just b first.
When runtime UI behavior changes, validate with just r after a successful build and wait for startup validation errors to surface.
Do not add ad-hoc validation scripts for this migration.
